_comment: Hand-edited formatting for Google Scholar entries, keyed by Scholar citation id (the citation_for_view value). Any field here replaces what Scholar returns: title, authors (plain text, comma separated), venue (journal/book name, shown in italics), details (volume/issue/pages), prefix (text before the venue, e.g. 'Book chapter'), hide (true to omit). Citation counts and years always come from Scholar.
